P0.scope: Targeted remediation of OMEGA-001 (AI self-verification), OMEGA-002 (provenance forgery), and OMEGA-006 (lifecycle escalation)

contracts: P0-001: AI cannot propose verified notes
P0-002: AI cannot claim official provenance
P0-003: AI cannot claim user provenance
P0-004: AI cannot inject ACTIVE lifecycle at creation
P0-005: AI cannot escalate verification to verified via update()
P0-006: Provenance source_type is immutable post-creation
P0-007: Lifecycle update immutability regression check
P0-008: Direct controller attack protection without ToolRouter
P0-012: LearningEngine promotion restricted to partially_verified
P0-013: Zero partial write on rejected proposal
P0-014: Restart preserves attested trust state

I-001_through_I-012.type: Authoritative Memory Security and Trust Invariants
invariants: I-001: AI cannot self-verify (propose, update reject verified for AI)
I-002: AI cannot claim privileged provenance (user, official, experience, import rejected)
I-003: AI cannot inject escalated lifecycle at creation (only RAW, CLASSIFIED, NORMALIZED, REVIEW permitted)
I-004: Verification escalation requires authorized attestation (HUMAN, ADMIN only)
I-005: Provenance source_type is principal-scoped at creation and immutable thereafter
I-006: Security fields cannot be arbitrarily overwritten by caller payload
I-007: Rejected payloads never persist (atomic write, zero partial persistence)
I-008: MemoryController is the authoritative security boundary, independent of callers
I-009: Legitimate AI provenance (inference, ai, execution, unknown) continues working
I-010: LearningEngine cannot manufacture verified, only partially_verified
I-011: Supersession does not transfer verification or provenance trust attributes
I-012: Restart / reload preserves attested trust state

I-RETRIEVAL.scope: All memory queries across REST API and CLI fallback must delegate to MemoryController.search() under Principal.AI_AGENT. Unauthenticated os.walk traversals are prohibited.

P16_P17_P18.definition: Physical Desktop and Hardware Forensics Invariants

invariants.P16: Hardware Telemetry Immutability (VID, PID, Serial, capacity, System Host ID, timestamp, hash read-only)
invariants.P17: Friendly Name Isolation (user can alter logical labels and administrative tags without altering physical IDs)
invariants.P18: Forensics and Chain of Custody Integrity (transfers bind immutable hardware fingerprint to tamper-evident audit log)

P0-P18.interpretation: Concatenation of memory trust boundaries (P0-P15) with desktop/hardware forensics (P16-P18). It is an umbrella shorthand only and MUST NOT be interpreted as 19 sequential memory invariants.

final_nomenclature_verdict.summary: Security invariant nomenclature standardized across all active repository documentation. P0 is codified as Phase 4.3 Priority-0 Hardening, P0-001..P0-015 as test contracts, I-001..I-012 as canonical memory trust invariants, I-RETRIEVAL as the unified retrieval invariant, P1/P2/P3 as forensic priority tiers, P16..P18 as desktop/hardware forensics invariants, and P0-P18 as an umbrella shorthand. Zero production code or security logic was modified.
